name: Browser
summary: Optional local browser automation for authorized agents.
description: The existing Puppeteer automation engine, installed separately from the core. Uses a compatible local Chrome executable or an existing Puppeteer cache; Get never downloads a browser or imports a browsing profile. Browser API and agent tools keep their existing access checks and public-network restrictions. Native browser workspace distribution and Playwright MCP remain under separate evaluation.
permissions: Runs browser automation only when this app is enabled
Agent browser tools keep their existing separate grants
Keeps screenshots and downloads in the local data folder
Does not import existing browser profiles, cookies or passwords
